newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica working on 10 pct Telkom empowerment stake.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica working on 10 pct Telkom empowerment stake.

text.p: The South African government is still working on plans to make 10 percent of the equity of Telkom available to boost black empowerment, Posts, Telecommunications and Broadcasting Minister Jay Naidoo said on Wednesday.
"We have set aside 10 percent for empowerment purposes. We have not finalised what will be the precise vehicle we will use to deal with these shares," he told Reuters.

Together with the 30 percent stake in Telkom that is being sold to a consortium of SBC Communications Inc and Telekom Malaysia Bhd, the empowerment deal will reduce the state's holding in Telkom to 60 percent.
